facts.text: I think it is unsettling to see that Huxley's predictions in Brave New World are still relevant in today's world.
I feel like we are slowly moving towards a dystopian society.
I wonder how far we are willing to go to sacrifice our freedom for stability.
I think it is scary that we may be giving up personal freedom for the illusion of safety and stability.
I think it is alarming that many people in today's world have become apathetic toward personal freedom and autonomy.
I think many people in today's world would rather follow the status quo and be comfortable than fight for their rights.
I find the trend of apathy toward personal freedom and autonomy alarming because it could easily lead to a dystopian society.
